versions.content: RTEEvent The description of an RTEEvent includes two as- pects: 1. defining an RTEEvent 2. defining how the RTE should deal with the RTEEvent when it occurs.
RTEEvent The description of an RTEEvent includes two as- pects: 1. defining an RTEEvent 2. defining how the RTE should deal with the RTEEvent when it occurs.

RTEEvent An RTEEvent defines: • what the trigger for the occurrence of that RTEEvent is • whether specific ModeDeclaration s disable the processing of this RTEEvent • which RunnableEntity shall be started when this RTEEvent occurs.
